data.name: CreateOpportunity
data.description:
CreateOpportunity creates an Opportunity record in Partner Central. Use this operation to create a potential business opportunity for submission to AWS. Creating an opportunity sets Lifecycle.ReviewStatus to Pending Submission.
To submit an opportunity, follow these steps:

To create the opportunity, use CreateOpportunity.
To associate a solution with the opportunity, use AssociateOpportunity.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates an opportunity in AWS Partner Central for submission to AWS, initially marking it pending submission. Associate a solution separately before submitting.
Use for: create partner opportunity, prepare AWS submission, add opportunity details
Not supported: solution association, opportunity submission, opportunity updates

data.name: Opportunities Closing Soon (Explicit AND)
data.evaluateGuide:
Runs a Salesforce GraphQL query for opportunities closing soon using explicit AND conditions. Use it to retrieve matching opportunity data.
Use for: find closing opportunities, apply AND filters, query opportunity fields
Not supported: creating opportunities, updating records, product schedules

data.name: CreateOpportunity
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates an opportunity record in AWS Partner Central. Use it to begin preparing a potential business opportunity for AWS partner submission.
Use for: create opportunity, start partner submission, record business details
Not supported: solution association, submission, opportunity retrieval

data.name: Product Schedules
data.description:
Work with revenue and quantity schedules for opportunity products. Establish or reestablish a product schedule with multiple installments for an opportunity product. Delete all installments in a schedule.
This resource is available in REST API version 43.0 and later.
In API version 46.0 and later, established and re-established schedules support custom fields, validation rules, and Apex triggers. Deleting all schedules now also fires delete triggers.
https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_re
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves revenue and quantity schedule installments for a Salesforce opportunity product. Use it to inspect an opportunity product’s schedule.
Use for: view product schedules, inspect installments, retrieve schedule data
Not supported: creating schedules, deleting installments, updating opportunity products

data.name: [Simulate] CreateOpportunity - For Reject
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates an AWS Partner Central opportunity for a rejection simulation flow. Use it to prepare test data for the reject scenario.
Use for: simulate rejected opportunity, test rejection flow, create test opportunity
Not supported: production submission, solution association, general opportunity retrieval

data.name: Get Default Values to Create a Record
data.description:
Get the default values for fields for a new record of a specified object and optional record type. After getting the default values, make a request to POST /ui-api/records to create the record.
The response contains the default field values for the Full layout type for a new record of the object type specified in .
It also contains the corresponding layout for create mode. In the Salesforce user interface, an admin with “Customize Application” permission can mark a field as required in a
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves default field values and the create layout for a new Salesforce record of a specified object type. Use the response to prepare a subsequent record-creation endpoint call.
Use for: get record defaults, inspect create layout, prepare new record
Not supported: creating records, updating fields, deleting records

data.name: Create opportunity
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a CRM opportunity through Apideck’s unified CRM API. Use it to add a new opportunity with supplied values to a connected CRM system.
Use for: create CRM opportunity, add sales opportunity, sync opportunity data
Not supported: opportunity retrieval, deletion, stage history

data.name: User Messages, General
data.description:
Returns all the messages for all the private conversations for the context user. Also used to search across all messages and post a message.
To return all private conversations for the context user, see User Conversations, General.
https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.chatterapi.meta/chatterapi/connectresourcesusersmessagesgeneral.htm
data.evaluateGuide:
Posts a message to private Salesforce Chatter conversations for the context user and can search across messages. Use it for private conversation messaging.
Use for: send private message, search messages, message recipients
Not supported: public posts, conversation management, opportunity operations

data.name: Create Order From Quote
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a Salesforce order from an existing quote using the standard action endpoint. Use it to convert an eligible quote into an order.
Use for: create order from quote, convert approved quote, generate sales order
Not supported: creating quotes, editing orders, retrieving quote details
